title: This Totally Free App Can Free Up Space on Your Mac

claims.claim: Purge is a totally free, open source app that helps clean up Mac hard drives without ads or upsells.

evidence.quote: This totally free, open source app gives you a quick breakdown of what's taking up space on your hard drive and offers a few specific ways to free it up. Even better: There are no ads or upsells.

claims.claim: Purge can delete Apple Intelligence's offline models from macOS 27, freeing up over 10 GB of space.

evidence.quote: Purge can even delete Apple Intelligence's offline models from macOS 27, which could free up over 10 GB.

claims.claim: Purge sends files to the Trash instead of deleting them outright so they can be recovered.

evidence.quote: Finally, Purge sends files to the Trash instead of deleting them outright, so you can always recover them if something breaks.

claims.claim: Purge includes a tool to clean safe items, delete caches, and remove Apple's Aerial screen savers.

evidence.quote: If you want, click the Clean Safe Items button, and the app will handle it, assuming you trust it. I recommend paying a bit more attention, though. First, delete some caches. You'll see a list of caches, all of which are safe to purge periodically. You'll also see Apple's Aerial screen savers here. These videos are very cool, but take up a lot of space—delete them if you, like most 21st-century people, don't use a screen saver.

If you want, click the Clean Safe Items button, and the app will handle it, assuming you trust it. I recommend paying a bit more attention, though. First, delete some caches. You'll see a list of caches, all of which are safe to purge periodically. You'll also see Apple's Aerial screen savers here.

claims.claim: Purge features a Dev Tools section that can delete cached installation files for Homebrew users.

evidence.quote: There's also a Dev Tools section, which isn't relevant for most people. If you use Homebrew, though, don't skip this—it's an easy way to delete cached installation files you don't need anymore.

claims.claim: Purge has a tool for uninstalling apps that removes associated files like settings and caches along with the application.

evidence.quote: Up next is a tool for uninstalling apps. Note that this doesn't just remove the application—it also removes every file associated with it, including your settings, caches, and anything the application downloaded.

claims.claim: Purge includes a tool that shows leftover data and files from applications that have already been deleted.

evidence.quote: Speaking of that, there's also a tool that shows leftover data from applications you've already deleted.

claims.claim: Apple's recent operating systems come preloaded with offline AI models that power features like notification summaries, writing suggestions, and Siri.

evidence.quote: Apple's most recent operating systems come preloaded with offline AI models, which power things like notification summaries, writing suggestions, and the new AI-powered Siri.
